title: January 2026
about: The 19 to 21 January 2026 storm: an S4 solar radiation storm, the strongest since October 2003, with a G4 geomagnetic storm. NOAA's own warnings are the records here; what operators did is not yet published.

s4.note: S4 measured by GOES-19 and Kp 8.33 in the 18 to 21 UTC block

records.happened: NOAA warned of higher radiation on polar routes and notified airlines and the FAA.
records.means: told to keep flights off polar routes and lower

records.happened: NOAA warned of higher radiation exposure for astronauts and notified NASA.
records.means: told to bring anyone outside back in

records.happened: NOAA flagged enhanced risk to satellites, especially in geostationary orbit.
records.means: told what threatens a geostationary satellite

records.happened: NOAA warned of loss of HF communications over the horizon in polar regions.
records.means: told to route around the poles

records.happened: NOAA's S4 description includes single event upsets in satellite electronics, and it notified airlines and the FAA.
records.means: told an unexplained avionics fault may be radiation

notCovered.what: What airlines and satellite operators actually did in January 2026 is not yet published.
notCovered.why: These records are NOAA's warnings, so they check the advice against what NOAA said mattered, not against an outcome.
